newsitem.title: USA: Hon Industries sees double-digit growth.
newsitem.headline: Hon Industries sees double-digit growth.

text.p: Hon Industries Inc said Monday it expected to report double-digit increases in earnings and sales for the year.

"We are on track to realize our goal of double-digit increases in sales and earnings for 1997," the company's chairman and chief executive Jack Michaels said in a statement. "Our businesses continue to show healthy growth, and new account sales and account retention rates remain high."

"This growth is being driven by our two strong core industries and by the introduction of new products, which expand our appeal to existing customers and allow Hon to enter new market segments," Michaels said.
Earlier, Hon Industires reported net income rose to $18.8 million, or $0.63 a share, during the second quarter from $12.3 million, or $0.41, in the same period last year.

Hon said it gained market share in each of its core businesses, medium-priced office furniture and fireplaces. Office furniture sales rose 22.1 percent during the quarter. Sales of hearth products rose 175.9 percent with the contribution of a recent acquisition, Heat-N-Glo.
